glosses: bar, coffee shop, café, pub (an establishment where refreshments and alcohol drinks are served)

examples.text: Tom no aprobó que Mary cantara en bares.
examples.en: Tom disapproved of Mary singing in bars.

examples.text: A una amiga mía le encanta ir a los bares gays conmigo.
examples.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.

examples.text: Tom se sentó en el bar.
